So you're losing roughly two out of every three people who've already pulled out their wallet and reached the payment screen.

That pattern doesn't come from traffic quality or creative — both upstream numbers are good. It's checkout friction: a surprise shipping charge appearing at the last step, a forced account login, or missing UPI/COD options. On Indian snack carts, no-COD and no-UPI alone can torch conversion.

Caveat: 926 purchases is enough to trust the rate, but watch for one thing — if a big chunk of carts are bundle/threshold abandons (people gaming a free-shipping line), the 'leak' is partly intentional and worth less than it looks.
